title: Canon File
description: Validates the WHOLE canon.json file -- the frozen, hash-versioned, cross-segment name/realia glossary. entries{} holds resolved ACCEPTED canon-entry.schema.json-shaped records keyed by source_form; review_queue[] holds low-confidence/disputed candidates in the QUEUED shape from canon-batch.schema.json's discriminated union (disposition:"review_queue"); generation_hashes stamps the particle_config/derivation-bundle provenance canon.json was generated under, so select_segments.py's derivation-state gate can detect staleness. corrections[] (OPTIONAL, #495; disposition:"dismiss" added by #653) logs out-of-band adjudicated corrections -- to entries{} (disposition:"correct"/"remove") or to review_queue[] (disposition:"dismiss", entries{} untouched). Those three keys are required unconditionally -- a merge that skipped either generation_hashes stamp, or that never initialized review_queue, must fail schema validation loudly rather than be discovered later mid-dispatch.

entries.description: Resolved, ACCEPTED canon entries keyed by source_form.

review_queue.description: Low-confidence/disputed candidates, each in the QUEUED shape from canon-batch.schema.json's discriminated union -- not yet resolved into entries{}.

corrections.description: OPTIONAL, append-only log of out-of-band adjudicated corrections applied by canon_validate.py --correct (#495; disposition:"dismiss" added by #653) -- each item is the correction document verbatim. disposition:"correct"/"remove" logs a change to an entries{} record (the old value, the new one or its absence, and the operator's stated reason); disposition:"dismiss" logs a review_queue[] row dropped as not canon-worthy (the dismissed row and the operator's stated reason) -- entries{} is untouched by it. Optional because every canon.json written before #495 has none, and absence must stay valid; the merge path never creates or touches it. NOT part of what generation_hashes is a provenance claim about in the sense that matters: --correct deliberately carries the stamp forward verbatim rather than restamping (a content correction must not clear select_segments.py's derivation-state gate with nothing regenerated -- #291), and the re-stale signal for a corrected entry comes from cache_key.py's per-segment used_terms_hash instead.

generation_hashes.description: Provenance stamps recorded at merge time by the glossary-pass merge step -- NEVER manifest.json. particle_config_hash and derivation_bundle_hash together let select_segments.py's derivation-state gate detect an edit to the particle config or to bootstrap_names.py/segpack.py since this canon.json was last (re)generated.
